identitySignals: Agenda item is a Proposition 39 Facilities Use Agreement handled by OUSD's Office of Charter Schools; Francophone Charter School of Oakland is an OUSD-authorized charter school that has had Prop 39 agreements with OUSD (OUSD Legistar File 19-1455, 2019-20)
Located in Oakland, CA; its website says it is authorized by OUSD

Name differs from the agenda: agenda says 'Francophone Academy' while the registered and official name is 'Francophone Charter School of Oakland'; no source found mentioning 'Francophone Academy' or a rename, so the match rests on being the only Francophone charter school in OUSD
research.notes: Agenda name 'Francophone Academy' does not exactly match 'Francophone Charter School of Oakland'; likely shorthand, but a reviewer should confirm. Address omitted because campus addresses vary across sources (Lawlor St vs Coolidge Ave).

profile.summary: A tuition-free public charter school in Oakland, California, serving students in transitional kindergarten through 8th grade. It offers a French and English dual-immersion program. The school is authorized by Oakland Unified School District and is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) organization.
